scope: LIBERO simulation only; excludes the earlier 2026-09-01 identical-object experiment
research_question: Does the identity/content of one interaction-memory pulse change closed-loop behavior from an exactly shared correct-memory prefix?

execution_host.gpus: 8 x NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, 49140 MiB each
execution_host.note: The evaluation worktree contains prior research changes; critical executable files are frozen by SHA256 below.

checkpoint.hash_recipe: find CHECKPOINT -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum

shared_protocol.wrong_prompt_definition: Highest token-Jaccard prompt among other tasks in the same suite; only the memory extractor receives it, while the action prefix remains correct.
shared_protocol.shuffled_definition: A frozen current_memory tensor from a different pre-registered sample; tensor shape and model normalization match the target condition.

sampling.method: Deterministic stratified random sample selected before any new rollout outcome was observed.
sampling.candidate_universe: LIBERO-10 task_id 1..10, episode_id 0..9; early replan 12..24, middle 36..52, late 64..80.
exclusions: Previously intensively analyzed task 9 episodes 3, 6, and 8 are not target points.
The earlier identical-object stress test is outside this protocol.

endpoints.primary_closed_loop: Paired task success: correct vs shuffled.
endpoints.local_action: L2 over the five executed branch actions, split into translation, rotation, and gripper components.

outcome_rules.success: LIBERO environment reports task completion before the fixed step limit.
outcome_rules.task_completes_before_branch: Retained and marked intervention_not_reached; not replaced based on outcome.
outcome_rules.prefix_or_branch_audit_failure: Retained as protocol-invalid with the exact failure; rerun is allowed only with identical settings after an infrastructure/code fix.
outcome_rules.server_or_encoding_failure: Retained as infrastructure failure; rerun the same point without substituting another sample.
outcome_rules.reporting: All four registered points and every condition are reported, including concordant outcomes and negative examples.

pilot_decision_gate.purpose: Validate lockstep correctness and logging, not estimate a publishable effect.
pilot_decision_gate.pass: At least 3 of 4 points reach the branch, satisfy all four audit checks, and produce complete summaries, trajectories, and videos for every condition.
pilot_decision_gate.fail: Do not expand; repair only the protocol/infrastructure issue and rerun the same registered points.
pilot_decision_gate.expansion: If the pilot passes, freeze a new independent 20-50 point target list without using pilot intervention outcomes for selection.

statistical_plan_after_expansion.primary: correct vs shuffled discordant counts, paired success-rate difference, exact McNemar test, and 95% confidence interval
statistical_plan_after_expansion.secondary: The same outputs for correct vs zero and correct vs injection_off
statistical_plan_after_expansion.small_n_rule: The four-point pilot is reported descriptively and is never used for a headline significance claim.
